about_the_game:
Frontera is a fantasy city builder and colony sim where you start with a small camp at the edge of a dark island. Build up a settlement and economy to both fulfill your unit's wants and gear them up to fight their way across the island!

Establish production chains from gathering raw resources to refining them into tools, weapons, and amenities.

Store and bring products to the markets, where settlers will make purchases based on their needs and desires. Collect income from these purchases and housing. Settlers will purchase new tools on their own to increase their work productivity,

Use your collected funds to attract more settlers and license technology from the guilds. Build and upgrade guild outposts to train your units to be more efficient at production.

Raise an army to establish and defend outposts that will grant passive resource generation. Engage monsters and watch as your units fight automatically! Reinforce fights as they happen in real time!

Make your way to deal with the source of the islands monster infestation, after which the island will be secured!
